mapper.select: SELECT question_bank_id, COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) AS cnt FROM question_bank_question WHERE question_bank_id IN #{id} GROUP BY question_bank_id

SELECT bq.question_bank_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.question_id) AS cnt FROM question_bank_question bq INNER JOIN submission s ON s.question_id = bq.question_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.verdict = 'ACCEPTED' AND s.is_delete = 0 WHERE bq.question_bank_id IN #{id} GROUP BY bq.question_bank_id
